text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — cloud partner co-launch checklist. Need final timeline, webinar date, benchmark narrative, and inbound lead routing. Can the group confirm owners? :rocket:
Ben Ortiz: Shared a working doc: https://docs.google.com/example — proposed webinar on Oct 12 to avoid product week conflicts. Thoughts? :calendar:
Tara Singh: Oct 12 works for ops. Proposed speakers: Maria (intro), Ashwin (tech demo), Kevin (customer panel). We need ~4 weeks for slides + dry run.
Ashwin Patel: Demo will show the integration flow + performance slides. Can we lock the model variant and instance sizes for bench runs? Numbers move otherwise.
Kevin Lo: CloudCo confirmed the customer panel, they want guidance on talking points (developer DX + ROI). I can draft a one-pager.
Maria Chen: For benchmarks — keep narrative short: 3 core comparisons (latency at 512 tokens, cost per 1k tokens, throughput at peak). @Ben can you own visuals for both blog and webinar?
Ben Ortiz: Yep. I'll pull numbers from the perf deck and make 3 clean charts. Which model variant — Redwood-fast vs Redwood-quant? Pick one to avoid churn.
Tara Singh: Marketplace listing needs: logo, 250-word blurb, 2 screenshots (dashboard + integration). Partner asked for co-branded hero image. Deadline: EOD next Wed.
Maria Chen: Inbound lead routing proposal: marketplace leads -> HubSpot form -> campaign "CloudPartner-Q4" -> assign to regional SDR pool. SLA: respond within 24h. Mark as MQL if job_title contains "Engineer" or "Product". Also include utm params.
Ashwin Patel: Routing webhook example for devs to wire up: ```POST /integrations/hubspot/receive?token=REDACTED
{ "source": "marketplace", "utm_campaign": "cloudpartner-q4", "email": "...", "job_title": "..." }
if (source == 'marketplace' && utm_campaign == 'cloudpartner-q4') assignPool('sd-eng');```
olivia (sales): Add a "lead_age" tag for freshness and an "interest_level" field captured at signup. We can auto-claim leads <6h to SDRs in the region. Also please include "product_interest" checkbox on the form.
Ben Ortiz: UTM scheme for blog + emails: utm_medium=partner, utm_source=cloudmarket, utm_campaign=cloudpartner-q4. Please ensure links use final campaign id.
Tara Singh: Draft run-of-show for webinar: 1) 5m intro, 2) 15m live demo, 3) 15m customer panel, 4) 10m benchmark walk-through, 5) 10m Q&A + CTA. Dress rehearsal Tue before. Who owns slides+speaker notes?
Kevin Lo: I'll own the customer panel notes and coordinate with CloudCo on the talking points. Will share draft by Sept 28.
Ben Ortiz: Blog timeline: draft by Sep 22, internal review Sep 25, publish Oct 9 (3 days before webinar). Need CloudCo quote + headshot.
Maria Chen: Action items recap: Ben = visuals & blog, Tara = marketplace assets & ops, Ashwin = demo & benchmark config, Kevin = customer one-pager & panel, olivia = lead routing rules & SLA. I'll consolidate in the GDoc and ping partners. Everyone ok with deadlines?
olivia (sales): :thumbsup: will prepare routing rules doc for Ops.
Ashwin Patel: :white_check_mark: I'll start the bench runs once we lock model/instance.
Ben Ortiz: :thumbsup: starting visuals tomorrow.
Tara Singh: :rocket: I'll chase partner for the co-brand hero and screenshots.
Maria Chen: Great — I'll schedule a 30m sync for Friday to finalize slide owners and confirm Webinar ops. Thanks all.
deploy-bot: Reminder: calendar invite for "Cloud Partner Webinar dry run" created for 2024-10-08 16:00 UTC.
